questions.stem: A pediatrician is evaluating a newborn for potential metabolic disorders due to some concerning symptoms. Given the suspicion of phenylketonuria (PKU) among other metabolic conditions, the pediatrician considers the most effective screening method to identify such diseases in their early stages. Which screening test is considered the gold standard for detecting PKU and similar metabolic disorders in newborns?
